_: English voice-over and captions for the demo video. Each scene maps to a span of a REAL recording (marks from record_ui.py / the terminal clip); sentences are spoken in order and shown as captions. If the voice-over is longer than the span, the last frame is held (a freeze frame, never new content).

title.title: Sauti Pesa
title.subtitle: Offline Swahili and English voice wallet for USDT · on-device AI with QVAC · self-custody with WDK
title.kicker: AI Yako: Own Your AI · On-device agentic finance
lines: Sauti Pesa is a Swahili and English voice wallet for USDT. The AI runs on your own device, even with the internet off.

scenes.subtitle: AI and wallet in a sandbox with no network

lines: First, the proof. This computer is online: a normal web request gets an answer.
The app's AI and wallet run in a sandbox with no network at all: no DNS, no route, only the loopback interface.
The engine checks this itself and refuses to start if the internet is reachable. Then QVAC loads Whisper and Qwen3 on the CPU.

scenes.section: 2 · Pay by voice or text, offline
scenes.subtitle: Every payment is checked by plain code before signing

lines: In the app, the status pill shows it live: AI on this device, network off, verified.
A Swahili voice note: send my brother Juma fifteen USDT for school fees.

lines.text: Whisper transcribes it on the device, and Qwen3 turns it into a payment.
All of it runs on this laptop's CPU, with no GPU and no cloud.
Plain code then checks the contact, the address, the amount, the limits and scam signs.
On confirm, the WDK wallet signs it offline, and it waits in the outbox.

lines: English works too. Here it is typed: forty USDT to Otieno for rent.

lines.text: The model only proposes. The code decides.
The side panel shows what ran on this CPU, and how long each step took.

lines: Now an address-poisoning attack: an address that starts and ends like Amina's, but is not hers.

lines.text: The code blocks it, and a blocked payment cannot be confirmed.

lines: Check-a-message mode: paste a suspicious text message.

lines.text: A Swahili prize message that asks for a fee first is rated high risk, and the app says why.
Above fifty USDT, the amount must be typed again before anything is signed.

scenes.subtitle: A separate sender with no keys broadcasts the outbox

lines: Back online, a separate sender with no keys broadcasts the signed payments, in nonce order.

lines.text: Each raw transaction is checked against its outbox record first.
